answer: A payout is split so that 29% arrives at settlement and the rest over 18 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The copper schedule is applied in relic and yarrow shows each instalment. An attacker therefore cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 4365 identities would post 664 proofs and burn roughly 23 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
